title: Reference amplitude evaluation and cost model
statement: Under BCM-1, the closed coefficient formula evaluates one reference amplitude in O(R) big-integer operations, the frozen enumeration producer performs exactly sum_{j<R} C(Q-1,j)2^j indicator tests per amplitude call, and all amplitude classes fit in a table of at most QR entries; row assembly is conditional on explicit ring-unit hypotheses.
verified: closed coefficient route equals the frozen enumeration producer on 163,912 bounded calls
row assembly equals the reference route on 10,476 rows over the rationals and Z/25
the required unit hypotheses refuse node 5 modulo 25 and denominator 2 modulo 8
the corrected evidence replays from a clean extraction of the sealed r7 source package and from this repository checkout
unresolved: native executable realization and cost model
nonclaims: not a total owner-sum cost theorem
not a claim about an executable native entry
smallest_decisive_test: Bind the closed amplitude route to an executable native entry under an explicit cost model, or exhibit the first exact source-level obstruction to that transport.
